about_the_game:
[Visit the page of "Darkness : Prince of Shadows"]

Darkness: Prince of Shadows

An ancient evil has been unleashed, and humanity stands on the brink of destruction. In Darkness: Prince of Shadows, you experience an epic 2.5D dark-fantasy hack & slash sidescroller adventure with platforming elements, moral dilemmas, and a brutal, cinematic combat system

Two heroes. One blood-stained destiny.

An ancient prison has been breached. Eternal evil has awakened. The world teeters on the edge of collapse, and only two rebellious souls stand between humanity and absolute damnation.

Alis, raised within the silent walls of a convent, learned the art of survival through faith and theft. Agile, swift, and deadly, she’s known as the Demon Striker — because, as she herself says, “there’s no fame in death.”

Reyu, son of the legendary warlord Vlader and Princess Amelina, embodies strength and honor in battle. His determination is unbreakable: a true warrior never falls to blade.

Mystical and Devastating Combat

Fight with enchanted weapons and unique abilities. Unleash special moves like:

  • Impact Berserk, a ground slam generating an energy explosion that repels and annihilates weaker enemies.

  • Aerial Kick, which launches enemies into the air and slows time, allowing an instantaneous flurry of shots without consuming ammo.

Platforming, Traps & Environmental Challenges
Navigate gothic, perilous environments: precise jumps, strategic rolls, grappling hooks, and deadly traps will test your reflexes and wit.

Moral Puzzles & Karmic Choices
Face puzzles to save lives or decide to leave them to their fate. Your decisions influence karma, altering rewards and story progression.

  • Help those in need by donating energy to gain positive karma and rare rewards.

  • Ignore or condemn them, and receive Orbs—the in-game currency used for upgrades, purchases, and regeneration.

Progression & Resources

  • Merchants to buy items and upgrades

  • Altars to combine materials and craft new tools

  • Sacred fountains offering health, energy, or ammo as needed

Key Features

  • Two playable protagonists with unique styles and deep lore

  • Special moves and combat inspired by God of War and Dante’s Inferno

  • Rich medieval dark-fantasy setting full of atmosphere

  • Environmental and moral puzzles that impact gameplay

  • Karma system influencing rewards, choices, and endings

  • Dynamic platforming with obstacles, grappling hooks, and traps

  • Exploration, NPCs, and side quests

  • Orb-based economy and crafting

  • Selectable voice acting and full controller support

“Et fiat lux.”
This is their creed. This is their mission.

Here's the translated text, maintaining the original formatting:

About this Demo

The Darkness: Prince of Shadows demo offers a comprehensive taste of the first two training levels of the final game. Within them, you can:

  • Face the demo with two different characters (Alis and Reyu)

  • Take on an early boss fight

  • Overcome platforming sections with jumps, traps, and grappling hook usage

  • Solve environmental puzzles

  • Fight low-level enemies with two different weapons

  • Try out the "Berserk" secret moves

  • Explore and interact with the inventory, merchant, and altar systems

  • Experiment with the basics of the karma system and crafting

  • This demo represents the introductory levels of the full game, designed to introduce the main mechanics and provide a first taste of the dark-fantasy world of Darkness: Prince of Shadows.

short_description: The world is on the brink of the abyss. Only you can defeat demon hordes, solve puzzles, and use your skills to save humanity from eternal damnation. Improve your abilities, avoid corruption, and retrieve the only object that can save the world.
